title: AI Bridge
description: Feature-rich AI bridge powered by Gemini
body:
# **Steno's AI Bridge**
A highly customizable bridge from Gemini AI to your Minecraft chat. 
## Features:
- /ai or /bridge to open the settings menu
- Customizable appearance in chat (prefix, colors, etc.)
- /ai <message> to query
- @Trigger <message> to query
- Highly customizable system prompts
- Much more planned!
## Setup:
1. Obtain an API key from aistudio.google.com
2. Paste into /ai and configure other settings
3. Click 'Save Changes' and ask away!
